newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Diagnostic ends talks with Alliance Imaging.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Diagnostic ends talks with Alliance Imaging.

text.p: U.S. Diagnostic Labs Inc said on Wednesday that it discontinued talks to acquire Alliance Imaging Inc.
U.S. Diagnostic said it continues to see long-term value in Alliance and may explore joint opportunities with the firm in the future.
On August 19, U.S. Diagnostic Labs said it offered to acquire Alliance Imaging for about $65-$70 million.

"We were forced to announce our interest in Alliance far earlier than we would have preferred due to a significant increase in the price of their stock over the last several weeks. We attribute this increase to rumors of their takeover," said Jeffrey Goffman, U.S. Diagnostic's chairman and chief executive officer.
"We wanted to quickly alert the marketplace that we have no further interest in pursuing the purchase of Alliance Imaging."
U.S. Diagnostic was not immediately available for further comment.
U.S. Diagnostic Labs owns 55 diagnostic imaging facilities and manages 17 other radiology facilities in 12 states and has announced plans to acquire an additional 22 facilities.
